memory:memory/2026-04-16.md:1:25.snippet: # 2026-04-16 ## Bridge Resilience Improvements (Issue #11) Joel requested the bridge handle API interruptions more gracefully. Shipped three changes: ### 1. `openclaw_client.py` — Retry + Circuit Breaker - Transient errors (timeouts, 429, 5xx) retry up to 3x with exponential backoff (5s → 10s → 20s) - Non-transient errors fail immediately - Circuit breaker opens after 5 consecutive failures, cools down 60s - Config-driven: `max_retries`, `base_backoff_seconds`, `request_timeout_seconds` ### 2. `github_channel.py` — Deferred Retry Queue + Dead Letter - Failed events use time-based deferral (30s → 60s → ... 10min cap) instead of immediate retry - Retry limit 3 → 5 to survive longer outages
